method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); dates in a small module (built-in date functions, no daydate), the rules in one module and the worker's questions in a seat module importing it; five regulative rules (s 113(1), s 38(4)(b), s 231(2), s 229(2), s 260A(2)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Work Health and Safety Act 2012 (SA), the South Australian register's current unauthorised RTF, version 1.7.2025, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/work-health-and-safety-act-2012.txt (text sha256 dcf6768985af19922fb88e5f528dbbe57360a9bc536a351eec3a69003719bf0e per the meta), retrieved from legislation.sa.gov.au on 2026-11-06 (the official register, not the Open Australian Legal Corpus); with regs 7, 8A, 24, 699 and 699A of the Work Health and Safety Regulations 2012 (SA), version 1.7.2026, as deposited at subjects/au/sa/work-health-and-safety-regulations-2012/registers/source-bundle/work-health-and-safety-regulations-2012.txt (text sha256 df471426dc1c2da749b8f16f218eab8857e99adb5df14f4058624cf35c857887 per the meta)

seat: the worker: the individual (or prospective worker) who is hurt, put at risk, stops unsafe work, is in a safety dispute, or is treated badly for raising safety, and who brings or presses a claim, review or prosecution request about it -- or, where a worker has died, the family member or personal representative asking on the worker's behalf (sawhs-seat.l4); the business, the regulator, inspectors, SAET, the DPP and the courts get no seat

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset

Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Focus: the provisions a claimant meets. In: s 4(2)-(4); s 5(1), (7), (8) (so far as they bear on who is a worker); s 7; s 19(1), (2); s 28(c); Part 2 Division 5 (ss 30, 30A, 31-34); Part 3 (ss 35-39); Part 5 Division 6 (ss 83-88, 85A); Part 5 Division 7A ss 102A, 102B, 102F and s 102C(4)'s penalty; s 103; Part 6 (ss 104-115); s 184; Part 12 ss 223, 224, 226, 228, 229; ss 230(1), (9) (gloss), 231, 232; s 260A; s 267 (with s 260); ss 272, 273; Regulations regs 24, 699, 699A (and 7, 8A in glosses). Out: Part 1 machinery and the advisory committee; Part 2 Division 1, ss 19(3)-(5), 20-27, 28(a), (b), (d), 29 (folded into 'a health and safety duty was owed'); Part 4; Part 5 Divisions 1-5 and 7, ss 89, 102C-102E; Parts 7-11 except s 184; Part 12 ss 225, 227 and s 223 item 13; Part 13 except ss 230-232, 260A, 267 (s 260 cited); Part 14 except ss 272, 273; Schedules. Reasons in NOTES.md.
